rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling unsupported or unable to manage without help.

example.english: I felt really helpless when I lost my job.
example.traditional: 我失業嗰陣真係好無助。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sat1 jip6 go2 zan6 zan1 hai6 hou2 mou4 zo6

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when helpless means having no way to solve the problem or get something done.

example.english: I’m helpless—I have no way to clean up this mess.
example.traditional: 呢個爛攤子我真係冇辦法收拾。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 laan6 taan1 zi2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 baan6 faat3 sau1 sap6

rows.note: Use this for being powerless to intervene or act effectively, especially in a serious or formal context.

example.english: Faced with this disaster, we were helpless to do anything.
example.traditional: 面對呢場災難，我哋都無能為力。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 ni1 coeng4 zoi1 naan6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 mou4 nang4 wai4 lik6

rows.jyutping: hou4 mou4 waan4 sau2 zi1 lik6
rows.note: Use this when someone is physically unable to fight back or defend themselves during an attack.

example.english: They were beaten until they were helpless to fight back.
example.traditional: 佢畀人打到毫無還手之力。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 daa2 dou3 hou4 mou4 waan4 sau2 zi1 lik6
